headline: Hungarian society has split dramatically: rising food prices are grinding away at families' money
summary: Hungarian households are spending a growing share of budgets on food, according to a Pénzcentrum report, despite a utility price cap, amid weak domestic food industry competitiveness.
why: Food inflation and household spending shares affect consumer demand, retail earnings and the central bank's inflation outlook.
